question: Who among the following is the Chief Election Commissioner of India as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunil Arora**__.

__
 
• **Sunil Arora is the Chief Election Commissioner of India as of January 2021.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)**

 
 
• The President appoints the Chief Election Commissioner, who has a** tenure of 6 years, or up to the age of 65 years**, whichever is earlier.
 
• The CEC enjoys the** same status and the salary** and perks as available to **Judges of the Supreme Court.**
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner can be **removed from his office only in a manner and on the grounds prescribed for removal of Judge of the Supreme Court.**
 
• Other** Election Commissioners** can be removed by the **President **on the recommendation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
 
• The Election Commission has the power of superintendence, direction and conduct of all elections to Parliament and the State Legislatures and of elections to the offices of the President and Vice-President.
 
• **Sunil Arora **was the Chief Election Commissioner of India in January 2021.
 
 
• He was the **23rd Chief Election Commissioner of India.**
 
 
 
 

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The current Chief Election Commissioner of India is Rajiv Kumar.
